svg.title: P1 Sketched part — cutting profile
svg.desc: Cutting profile, true scale: 1 user unit = 1 mm. Part-local CAD coordinates with the Y axis flipped for SVG: svg_x = cad_x, svg_y = −cad_y (CAD y-up → SVG y-down). data-* attributes carry true CAD values. Red (cut-outer): outer contour, cut last. Blue (cut-inner, hole): inner cut-outs and holes, cut first. Green (hole-centre): centre marks only, do not cut. Magenta: profiles of further Z layers, for reference. Stroke width 0.1 mm (hairline); kerf is not compensated.
